objective: Preparar o SuperEzio para trading real via TD Direct Investing Canada sem paper trading, scraping, credenciais TD ou transmissao automatica.

impact_map.problem: O runtime esta acoplado a IBKR/paper e nao possui um contrato seguro para entregar ordens live ao TD Direct Investing.
risks: confundir ticket local com ordem transmitida
ticker, bolsa ou moeda incompativeis
dimensionamento de risco incorreto
expor credenciais ou automatizar WebBroker contra os termos TD
quebrar contratos existentes de paper order
impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Adicionar ticket TD live manual fail-closed, somente LIMIT, sem senha, navegador ou broker submit; manter todo legado de transmissao congelado.

evidence.td_official_platforms: TD lista WebBroker, TD app, Advanced Dashboard e TD Active Trader; nenhuma API publica de ordens foi encontrada.
evidence.td_agreement: Electronic Brokerage Services Client Agreement, secao 6: acesso a conta/servicos/informacao somente pelos sites TD, nao por software de terceiros.
evidence.baseline: ruff completo passou; 71 testes direcionados passaram; API/modelo/broker offline; browser smoke falhou por conexao recusada.

milestone.delivered: Universo oficial de 108 ETFs sem comissao, filtro fail-closed e rascunho TD nao executavel.
milestone.verification: 58 testes direcionados passaram; ruff completo passou; rota live retornou 108; browser smoke ficou 503 porque CEO/model server esta offline.

active_patch.problem: O cockpit mostra Paper order submitted quando /trade/execute responde HTTP 200 com ok=false e submitted_to_broker=false.
active_patch.risk: Confundir ticket pendente com ordem transmitida.
active_patch.smallest_safe_patch: Exigir confirmacao positiva do corpo para mensagem de submit; caso contrario mostrar pending/not submitted.
active_patch.result: 39 tests passed; ruff and JS syntax passed; browser smoke passed with 130 candles and 7 canvases.

phase_2_impact_map.problem: Mangala tests use a temporary tracker journal but sync each flip into the default operator PaperJournal.
risks: test data written to operator journal
synthetic rows ingested into financial RAG
unrecoverable deletion during cleanup
breaking runtime singleton construction
phase_2_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Inject the PaperJournal destination into MangalaTracker, stamp environment/provenance, reject test rows in operator storage, and quarantine proven synthetic records without deletion.
verification: hash operator artifacts before and after tests
pytest Mangala, PaperJournal and UnifiedMemory tests
phase_2_impact_map.result: 48 tests passed; all five operator artifacts kept identical hashes across pytest; targeted Ruff passed; browser smoke passed with 130 candles and 7 canvases.

phase_3_impact_map.problem: Kill switch, approvals and trade status are process-memory state; restart loses safety decisions and can duplicate an intent.
risks: duplicate ticket across process restart
approval resolving a different ticket
kill switch returning inactive after restart
tests writing production financial state
partial audit write without replay evidence
phase_3_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Add one SQLite source of truth with unique fingerprint/event keys, inject it into global safety gates, persist endpoint status, and fail closed with dead-letter evidence on partial writes.
verification: operator database hash unchanged across pytest
Ruff, focused pytest and browser smoke
phase_3_impact_map.result: SQLite workflow state is cross-process idempotent; trade status survives restart; approvals are bound to one ticket hash; global kill switch survives restart and Guardrail Hub reads it; dead letters are durable; pytest and browser storage are isolated.

evidence.trace_quarantine: 187 pytest trace rows copied to runtime/quarantine; operator trace restored to its prior tracked content

phase_4_impact_map.problem: O rascunho TD persiste, mas ainda não possui máquina de estados broker-neutral para aprovação, entrada humana e confirmação externa.
risks: pular gate por transição arbitrária
aprovar ticket diferente
confundir entrada manual com transmissão pelo sistema
confirmar corretora sem referência e operador
phase_4_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Enforce allowed transitions, persist evidence events, require linked human approval and explicit operator/broker confirmations; expose no transport adapter.
phase_4_impact_map.result: Broker-neutral manual state machine enforced from draft through broker confirmation; every approval is hash-bound; manual entry requires fresh balanced TD preview costs; system_transmitted remains false; TD audit dead letters have idempotent replay.

evidence.operator_storage: trace, investor DB and PaperJournal hashes unchanged
evidence.lint: python -m ruff check src/ tests/ passed
evidence.broker_isolation: API regression raises if the manual TD workflow touches the IBKR adapter

phase_5_impact_map.problem: O cliente ainda declara preço, fonte e timestamp; esses campos podem ser falsificados e não verificam bolsa/moeda.
architecture_touched: provedores Twelve Data, Finnhub e yfinance
risks: fonte única ou mesma fonte duplicada
quote timestamp stale durante mercado fechado
bolsa/moeda divergente
provider timeout bloquear o servidor
fallback stale parecer live
phase_5_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Reject all client quote assertions; require two independent server providers with market timestamps, coherent exchange/currency and bounded divergence; no stale cache fallback for live tickets.
official_research: Twelve Data /quote returns exchange, currency and timestamp
Finnhub /quote returns current price and Unix timestamp t
phase_5_impact_map.result: TD drafts reject browser-supplied quote assertions and require two independent server providers with bounded age/divergence, coherent exchange/currency, immutable evidence hash, bounded transient retries and per-provider circuit breakers. No stale quote fallback is accepted.

phase_6_impact_map.problem: O ticket tem preço confiável, mas ainda pode ser promovido sem equity, buying power, posições, concentração, moeda e restrições da conta TD.

buying power insuficiente
concentracao por ativo, setor ou moeda
TFSA/RRSP/FHSA tratados como margem
SELL criar short acidental
duas ordens concorrentes consumirem o mesmo buying power
phase_6_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Require a fresh operator-attested TD account snapshot, compute every threshold server-side in CAD, reserve pending ticket notional transactionally, and only then call the existing immutable gate transition.
verification: boundary/property tests for quantity, currencies and limits
Ruff, focused pytest and browser smoke
phase_6_impact_map.result: A fresh operator-attested TD snapshot is validated with explicit TFSA/RRSP/FHSA/CASH/MARGIN rules; all risk and exposure math runs server-side in CAD; Bank of Canada FX evidence is required for USD; pending tickets reserve buying power and exposure transactionally across processes.

phase_7_impact_map.problem: A entrada manual aceita custos somente depois da aprovação; assim a aprovação atual não está ligada à comissão, spread, FX e fees vistos no preview TD.
architecture_touched: validação de preview no momento da entrada manual
risks: comissão zero virar bypass de risco
Easy Trade ou strategy order marcado como elegível
preview alterado depois da aprovação
FX e fees omitidos do custo total
lista oficial stale
phase_7_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Normalize and hash the official TD preview before approval, bind the approval to that context, and reject manual entry unless the repeated preview is byte-equivalent in economic fields.
verification: unexpected commission and incompatible condition tests
Ruff, focused pytest and browser smoke
phase_7_impact_map.result: The complete TD economic preview is recorded before approval and its hash is combined with ticket and Money Gate evidence. Manual entry must repeat the same economic preview; any commission, spread, FX, ECN, regulatory or other fee change is rejected and requires a new ticket approval.

ui_operational_truth_impact_map.problem: The cockpit conflates broker connectivity with core availability and renders idle components as failed or waiting.
risks: stale polling overwrites an active pipeline event
broker offline is displayed as system offline
hardcoded guardrail count appears as live evidence
journal events are presented as positions or open trades
ui_operational_truth_impact_map.smallest_safe_patch: Create one presentation-only snapshot from current health/details and runtime state, then make existing renderers consume it without changing trading or backend behavior.
verification: pytest plus browser smoke per repository policy
ui_operational_truth_impact_map.result: Core, CEO, data, mode, broker and pipeline render independently from one canonical snapshot. Idle experts render READY, trust remains null until F51 completes, guardrails never default to 30/30, Mangala renders IDLE PAPER, and PaperJournal records are not presented as broker positions.

api_responsiveness_impact_map.problem: Deep health and cockpit routes are declared async but perform slow synchronous broker and system probes, blocking unrelated requests and making chart/UI startup appear hung.

concurrent access to broker snapshot caches
changing public response contracts

verification: python -m ruff check on changed Python files
api_responsiveness_impact_map.result: FastAPI now schedules deep health, cockpit portfolio and cockpit summary in its threadpool. Slow broker/system probes no longer starve unrelated requests; public response contracts are unchanged.
